answer_1.quote: In the context of generative AI systems, attackers provide prompts, and annotators evaluate system responses to determine if they constitute safety failures.

answer_4.quote: Two annotators rate each dialogue on whether the targeted rule was broken on a four-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate whether model responses violate content safety rules (e.g., hate speech, discriminatory stereotypes) using a four-point Likert scale and provide reasoning.
